beat: Next-day film memories, college absences, Maami-store painting invitation and evening childcare

lines.original: After last night, Dhika felt more closer in friendship, to Raj. Strangely, this morning even while showering, she thought of Raj and remembered what happened the previous night at the movie.....
lines.local: Pichhli raat ke baad Dhika ko Raj se friendship mein zyada closeness mehsoos hui. Agli subah shower lete waqt bhi Raj aur pichhli raat movie mein jo hua, woh yaad aaya.

lines.original: Her hitting Raj's hands.... holding it on his thighs....him seeing her cute belly button.... and aiding her in fixing the saree......
lines.local: Raj ke haath par uske playful taps, uski thigh par rakha haath pakadna, Raj ka Dhika ki naabhi dekhna aur phir saree theek karne mein madad karna—sab yaad aaya.

lines.original: Unknowing to herself...., she even blushed a little.
lines.local: Jaane-anjaane woh thoda blush bhi kar gayi.

lines.original: college was mostly lame today.... with her having less classes, Sharmi on sick leave and twins were also not present today. When she called them, they said that they will be coming back to city only tomorrow and if possible, to let them join tuition with her tomorrow.....
lines.local: Aaj college mein zyada khaas kuch nahi tha: classes kam thin, Sharmi sick leave par thi aur twins bhi nahi aaye the. Phone par twins ne bataya ki agle din hi city lautenge aur mumkin ho toh us din tuition join karna chahenge.

lines.original: On the way back... she stopped at Maami's store to grab milk.
lines.local: Ghar lautte waqt Dhika doodh lene Maami ki store par ruki.

lines.original: Dhika: hey Chotu...maami not here...she waved and smiled at him.
lines.local: Dhika Chotu ko haath hilaate aur muskurate hue: Hey Chotu! Maami nahi hain?

lines.original: Chotu: she was here only didi....may be went out somewhere.... here, let me bill it for you.
lines.local: Chotu: Abhi toh yahin thin didi... shayad bahar gayi hongi. Laaiye, main aapka bill bana deta hoon.

lines.original: Dhika: dear... are you free today evening.... John is working in afternoon shift for a few days... and so, he will be coming very late. I thought, if you are free, we could do some..... painting... at late evening...
lines.local: Dhika: Dear, aaj shaam free ho? John kuch dino ke liye afternoon shift mein hai aur bahut late aayega. Socha agar tum free hue toh late evening mein thodi... painting kar sakte hain.

lines.original: Chotu: Feeling a little happy.... ofcourse didi... I will check with Maami and come if she doesn't have anything for me..
lines.local: Chotu khush hokar: Bilkul didi! Maami se poochhkar aata hoon, unko mere liye koi kaam nahi hua toh zaroor aaunga.

lines.original: Dhika: so sweet of you... she pinched his cheeks and bid him bye..
lines.local: Dhika: Kitne sweet ho! Usne Chotu ke gaal pinch kiye aur bye kaha.

lines.original: Reaching home.... she changed into a loose T shirt and a short skirt like yesterday and went to aunty's house(  with uncle not around, she didn't mind wearing short dresses to aunty's house). Pappu was still sleeping and with her not having anything much to do, as even twins were not coming... she stayed in aunty's house and chatted with her and helped her to clean the house a bit too...
lines.local: Ghar pahunchkar Dhika ne kal jaisi loose T-shirt aur chhoti skirt pehni aur Aunty ke ghar gayi. Uncle ghar par nahi the, isliye wahan short dress pehenkar jaane mein use dikkat nahi thi. Pappu abhi so raha tha; twins ki tuition bhi nahi thi, toh Dhika Aunty se baatein karti rahi aur unka ghar saaf karne mein thodi madad ki.

lines.original: Around 5 PM, she took sleeping Pappu back to her house and along with Pappu, she too slept a while.....
lines.local: Lagbhag shaam paanch baje Dhika soye hue Pappu ko apne ghar laayi aur uske saath khud bhi kuch der so gayi.

lines.original: Waking up to the sound of the door bell, she saw Pappu sitting on the bed, trying to play with cars by riding them on her. Giggling, she moved him and went to check who was at the door.
lines.local: Doorbell se Dhika jaagi. Pappu bed par baitha apni toy cars ko Dhika ke upar chalaakar khelne ki koshish kar raha tha. Dhika hansti hui use hataakar darwaza check karne gayi.

lines.original: Ding Dong.......
lines.local: Ding dong!

lines.original: Chotu: didiiiiiiii
lines.local: Chotu: Didiiii!

lines.original: Dhika: smiling... she opened the door.... Hey dear, come in...
lines.local: Dhika muskurakar darwaza kholte hue: Hey dear, andar aao!

lines.original: Chotu: Hiii,, I was free didi.... and remembered you asking me to come if I was free...
lines.local: Chotu: Hi! Main free tha didi, yaad aaya aapne free hone par bulaaya tha.

lines.original: Dhika: yes sweetie.... please sit. Can you wait a few minutes, I will be back.
lines.local: Dhika: Haan sweetie, baitho. Kuch minute wait kar sakte ho? Main abhi aayi.

lines.original: Chotu went and sat on the sofa.... While he was waiting he saw Dhika go into the bed room and in a few short minutes, she came back carrying Pappu in her hands. Pappu saw Chotu and struggled to get down from her hands to run to him.... but Dhika told him afterwards...... and took him straight out of the house and...... came back alone after 2 minutes.
lines.local: Chotu sofa par baith gaya. Usne Dhika ko bedroom mein jaate dekha; kuch hi minute baad woh Pappu ko god mein lekar nikli. Chotu ko dekhkar Pappu neeche utar kar uske paas bhaagna chahta tha, par Dhika ne 'baad mein' kaha aur use seedha ghar se bahar le gayi. Do minute mein akeli lauti.

lines.original: Seeing her close the door......
lines.local: Dhika ko darwaza band karte dekhkar...
